items.title: Can General Mills' New Operating Model Drive Profitable Growth?
items.summary: GIS' new operating model aims to streamline operations, sharpen commercial execution and drive long-term profitable growth through greater efficiency.

items.title: Can Estee Lauder's New Skin Science Strategy Fuel Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: EL's new Skin Longevity platform targets advanced skin care innovation, building on decades of research to unlock long-term growth opportunities.

items.title: Can Post Holdings' Foodservice Benefit From Normalized Egg Pricing?
items.summary: POST sees Foodservice earnings growth in fiscal 2027 as egg pricing normalizes, building on $500 million normalized earnings run rate.

items.title: BGS Q3 Earnings Top Estimates as Volumes and Margins Improve
items.summary: B&G Foods beats Q3 earnings estimates as higher volumes, portfolio changes and margin expansion fuel growth, prompting an increase in its fiscal 2026 outlook.

items.title: HAIN Q1 Loss Wider Than Expected on Weak Sales, Volume Declines
items.summary: Hain Celestial posts a wider-than-expected Q1 loss as sales and volumes decline, while margin gains, rising debt and refinancing uncertainties remain in focus.

items.title: Will Medifast's Metabolic Health Institute Strengthen Its Edge?
items.summary: MED advances its metabolic health strategy through a new Institute, proprietary science and Trilivy's phased wellness system.

items.title: Can Tyson Foods' New Partnership Strengthen Beef Supply Stability?
items.summary: TSN's proposed Allied Beef partnership and Amarillo production restart aim to stabilize cattle sourcing and boost beef output amid persistent cost pressures.

items.title: JBS N.V. (JBS) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Lag Estimates
items.summary: JBS N.V. (JBS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -38.46% and -0.83%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
